page.overview:
What is Quatza-Rij?

right|thumb|210px|The Ceremonial Mask made from the Quatza-Rij. The Quatza-Rij is a creature native to Yautja Prime, the homeworld of the . They are known as one of the fiercest creatures indigenous to Yautja Prime.

As a tradition, young Yautja hunters always hunt in groups of three. They are sent out in packs and must kill a single Quatza-Rij as a team in order to be recognized as adult clan members. Only after years of hunting, do the most skilled and experienced Yautja try to kill a Quatza-Rij on their own. If successful, they can break away from their pack and are allowed to travel off-world to hunt bigger game.

The Ceremonial mask is worn by the elder Predators during the "rite of passage" ceremony of the young hunters. It's fashioned from the skin and bone of one of the Quatza-Rij.

The Ceremonial mask has no laser sight, as it's not a hunting helmet, but is decorated with three circles on the forehead which represents each of the three hunters. The symbol of unity and teamwork, the Yautja laser sight is modeled after this symbol.
